olivia-finance: Sakura invoice INV-2026-0422 shows 10.21% JP withholding. Vendor asked us to gross-up per PO. @mike-tax @rachel-legal can you advise what docs we need?

sakura-payments: Hi Olivia — yes, withholding withheld at source. Vendor requests gross-up. They've uploaded a CoTR and a local tax agent note. Do you need a stamped CoTR from Japan or is a home-country CoTR OK?

mike-tax: For Japan payees, stamped CoTR + English translation preferred. Also need vendor Japanese TIN and a gross-up worksheet (net -> tax -> gross). If treaty applies reducing rate to 0% we won't gross-up.

rachel-legal: We'll only sign a gross-up addendum if we have: (1) stamped CoTR scan, (2) translation, (3) written description of withholding reason (services vs royalties), and (4) vendor TIN. Upload to secure link please.

payments-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0422 received. Amount: 980,000 JPY. Due: 2026-05-05. Status: awaiting vendor docs.

olivia-finance: Placing invoice on hold "tax docs pending" until vendor provides stamped CoTR + translation. Sakura — can you confirm currency (JPY) and bank SWIFT? We'll need those for gross-up calc.

sakura-payments: Bank is SMBC Tokyo, SWIFT: SMBCJPJT. Currency is JPY. We'll request stamped CoTR and vendor TIN from our AP contact and upload by EOD Thursday.

mike-tax: Great. Once we have stamped CoTR + TIN we'll check treaty position. If 10.21% stands we'll instruct AP on gross-up amount.

rachel-legal: I'll prepare our addendum template so it's ready. Note: if CoTR can't be stamped we'll deny gross-up.

olivia-finance: Thanks all :thumbsup: Sakura, please upload docs to https://files.redwood/upload and ping here when done.
